stem: 'You may go out to play only after you finish your worksheet.' Using a preferred activity to reinforce a less-preferred one illustrates:
explanation: The Premack Principle uses a high-probability behaviour (play) as a reinforcer for a low-probability one (finishing the worksheet) — sometimes called 'grandma's rule'.
